title: Continuous functions are integrable on open boxes of Euclid n
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let a, b ∈ ℝ be arbitrary (no order between a and b is assumed). Give ℝⁿ = Euclid n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) its Lebesgue measure, and write z_j for the j-th coordinate. If h : ℝⁿ → ℝ is continuous, then h is Lebesgue integrable on the open box B = {z ∈ ℝⁿ : a < z_j < b for all j ∈ Fin n}.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), Continuous h → IntegrableOn h {z : Euclid n | ∀ j, a < z j ∧ z j < b}
